Remove Mono browser runtime usage from build and test infrastructure.

## Description

Set `UseMonoRuntime=false` unconditionally in shared generated build props and propagate it to template-test child processes, including automatic restores from `dotnet new`. This avoids restoring Mono browser runtime packs while the WasmSdk default still selects Mono.

Samples and shipped templates are unchanged. Follow-up to #70440.
